title: A10 Vocabulary - Suffixes (后缀总表)
description: 初中与中考核心必考后缀构词总表，按名词、形容词、副词、动词后缀系统分类。

items.meaning: 表“……的人”或“做某事的工具/物品”
items.rule: **构词规律:** Verb / Noun + -er/-or -> Noun (人/物) | **本后缀词数:** 29

example.en: My favourite actor, the day before yesterday, I saw in a film.
example.cn: 我最喜欢的演员，我前几天在一部电影里看到了他。

example.en: There were ten strong competitors in the final running race.
example.cn: 在最后的赛跑中有十位强劲的对手。

example.en: We've got a cool computer.
example.cn: 我们有一台很棒的电脑。

example.en: Mum bought a modern electric cooker for our new kitchen.
example.cn: 妈妈为我们的新厨房买了一个现代化的电炉。

example.en: Customer
example.cn: 顾客

example.en: The film director shouted action.
example.cn: 电影导演大喊一声“开拍”。

example.en: For nurses and doctors.
example.cn: 献给护士和医生们。

example.en: The bus driver greeted every student with a warm smile.
example.cn: 公交车司机用温暖的微笑迎接每一位学生。

example.en: The local farmer grows wheat and corn in his fields.
example.cn: 当地的农民在他的地里种小麦和玉米。

example.en: A(n) inventor often has new and clever ideas.
example.cn: 发明家通常有很多新颖且巧妙的想法。

example.en: The zoo keeper feeds the baby pandas fresh milk every day.
example.cn: 动物园饲养员每天喂大熊猫宝宝新鲜牛奶。

example.en: Tom was chosen as the team leader because he is responsible and friendly.
example.cn: 汤姆被选为队长，因为他既负责又友好。

example.en: If you are a good listener, you will find good points to ask about.
example.cn: 如果你是一个好的倾听者，你会发现值得提问的好切入点。

words.meaning: 镜子；写照 `v.` 反射；反映

example.en: mirror
example.cn: 镜子

example.en: A police officer helped the lost tourist find the railway station.
example.cn: 一名警察帮助迷路的游客找到了火车站。

words.meaning: 所有者；物主; 业主；持有者

example.en: The app allows people to stay in homes around the world for free as long as they look after the owner's pet.
example.cn: 只要帮忙照顾主人的宠物，这个应用程序就允许人们免费住在世界各地的家中。

words.meaning: (职业)运动员，参赛选手；演员；演奏者

example.en: Find good sports players in your school.
example.cn: 在你们学校找找优秀的运动员。

example.en: Hi! I'm Lu Jiaqi, a school reporter.
example.cn: 嗨！我是陆家琪，一名校园记者。

example.en: It's next to the rubber.
example.cn: 它在橡皮旁边。

example.en: Use a ruler to draw a straight line.
example.cn: 用尺子画一条直线。

example.en: I want to be a singer in the future.
example.cn: 我将来想成为一名歌手。

example.en: The speaker gave a wonderful speech on communication.
example.cn: 演讲者就沟通发表了一场精彩的演讲。

example.en: Our teacher is patient and kind to all of us.
example.cn: 我们的老师对我们所有人都很有耐心也很亲切。

example.en: The bridge made it convenient for the villagers to travel across the river to the city.
example.cn: 这座桥给村民们过河去城里出行带来了便利。

example.en: Thousands of visitors come to see the museum every weekend.
example.cn: 每个周末都有成千上万的游客来参观这座博物馆。

example.en: A friendly waiter taught me a few words of Italian.
example.cn: 一位热情的服务生教了我几个意大利语单词。

example.en: You're the real winner!
example.cn: 你才是真正的赢家！

words.meaning: 工人, 人员, 工作者

example.en: Factory workers start work very early every morning.
example.cn: 工厂的工人们每天早上很早就开始工作。

example.en: The writer writes the passage to tell a touching story.
example.cn: 这位作家写这篇文章是为了讲一个感人的故事。

items.meaning: 表“……专业人员、学者或崇尚者”
items.rule: **构词规律:** Noun / Adjective + -ist / -ian -> Noun (人) | **本后缀词数:** 7

example.en: Once upon a time, a king asked an artist to paint him a horse.
example.cn: 从前，一个国王让一位艺术家给他画一匹马。

example.en: You should visit the dentist at least once a year for a checkup.
example.cn: 你每年至少应该去看一次牙医进行检查。

example.en: The musician played a sweet tune on the piano.
example.cn: 这位音乐家在钢琴上弹奏了一曲美妙的旋律。

example.en: The skilled magician pulled a white rabbit out of his black hat.
example.cn: 这位技艺娴熟的魔术师从黑色的礼帽中变出了一只白兔。

example.en: Lang Lang is an internationally famous Chinese classical pianist.
example.cn: 郎朗是一位国际知名的中国古典钢琴家。

example.en: I want to be a scientist in the future.
example.cn: 我将来想成为一名科学家。

example.en: Some of the tourists are from South China.
example.cn: 有些游客来自中国南方。

items.meaning: 表“参与者，施动者”或“相关事物”
items.rule: **构词规律:** Verb + -ant / -ent -> Noun (人/物) | **本后缀词数:** 5

example.en: The manager asked his assistant to print out the meeting documents.
example.cn: 经理让他的助手把会议文件打印出来。

example.en: Every contestant tried their best to win the game show.
example.cn: 每位参赛者都竭尽全力去赢得这个游戏节目。

example.en: The president gave an important televised address to the nation last night.
example.cn: 总统昨晚向全国发表了重要的电视讲话。

words.meaning: 仆人, 职员, 佣人

example.en: Some people think there will be flying cars and robot servants.
example.cn: 有些人认为未来会有飞行汽车和机器人仆人。

example.en: Every student should study hard every day.
example.cn: 每个学生每天都应该努力学习。

items.meaning: 表“动作、过程、结果或状态”
items.rule: **构词规律:** Verb + -tion / -sion -> Abstract Noun | **本后缀词数:** 25

example.en: This action helps plants grow.
example.cn: 这个动作有助于植物生长。

example.en: Pay close attention to your body language during the speech.
example.cn: 在演讲过程中要密切注意你的肢体语言。

example.en: Good communication skills are key to success in life.
example.cn: 良好的沟通技巧是人生成功的关键。

example.en: She won first place in the national English speech competition.
example.cn: 她获得了全国英语演讲比赛的第一名。

words.meaning: (1) 条件；(2) 环境；(3) 状态，状况

example.en: The old car is still in good condition.
example.cn: 这辆旧汽车状况仍然很好。

example.en: Congratulations on winning first prize at the school music festival!
example.cn: 祝贺你在学校音乐节上获得一等奖！

example.en: Please keep your voice down, this is a private conversation.
example.cn: 请小声点，这是私人谈话。

example.en: Does the writer give a clear description of the environmental problem?
example.cn: 作者对这一环境问题作出了清晰的描述吗？

example.en: I didn't mean to, but I gave them the wrong directions.
example.cn: 我不是故意的，但我给他们指错了方向。

example.en: We had a lively discussion about the class project.
example.cn: 我们针对班级项目进行了一场热烈的讨论。

words.meaning: (尤指学校)教育；有教益的经历

example.en: Students probably won't go to a school in the future for education.
example.cn: 未来学生们可能不会去学校接受教育。

words.meaning: 解释；说明；阐述；解释性说法；说明性文字

example.en: The teacher gave a clear explanation of the difficult math problem.
example.cn: 老师对这道难解的数学题做出了清晰的解释。

example.en: The useful expressions in the box will help you write the essay.
example.cn: 方框中有用的表达方式将帮助你写好这篇短文。

example.en: Read the instructions carefully before taking the medicine.
example.cn: 吃药前请仔细阅读说明书。

example.en: Each new member gave a brief self-introduction at the first meeting.
example.cn: 在第一次会议上，每个新成员都做了简短的自我介绍。

example.en: The internet is one of the greatest inventions in history.
example.cn: 互联网是历史上最伟大的发明之一。

words.meaning: 邀请的行为或实例；邀请函；请柬

example.en: I received an invitation to Tom's birthday party yesterday.
example.cn: 我昨天收到了汤姆生日派对的邀请函。

example.en: The doctor said the operation was successful and the patient was resting.
example.cn: 医生说手术很成功，病人正在休息。

example.en: Planting more trees along roads helps reduce air pollution.
example.cn: 在路边多种树有助于减少空气污染。

example.en: Population (2024) 18.978 million 0.76 million
Listening to tapes can help you improve your English pronunciation.
example.cn: 听录音带可以帮助你提高英语发音。

example.en: Environmental protection is everybody's responsibility.
example.cn: 环境保护是每个人的责任。

example.en: She helps me see the silver lining in difficult situations.
example.cn: 她帮助我在困境中看到一线希望。

example.en: Thank you for your helpful suggestion on my essay.
example.cn: 谢谢你对我文章提出的有益建议。

example.en: It is a Chinese tradition to eat dumplings during the Spring Festival.
example.cn: 春节吃饺子是中国的传统。

items.meaning: 表“动作、行为、过程或其结果”
items.rule: **构词规律:** Verb + -ment -> Abstract Noun | **本后缀词数:** 7

words.meaning: 乐趣；开心；娱乐；消遣活动；娱乐活动；(游乐场等的)娱乐设施

example.en: Disneyland is a popular amusement park for children and adults alike.
example.cn: 迪士尼乐园是深受儿童和成年人喜爱的游乐园。

example.en: The headmaster made an important announcement during the morning assembly.
example.cn: 校长在早会上作了一项重要宣布。

example.en: Christina has her own apartment, with her own car.
example.cn: 克里斯蒂娜有她自己的公寓，还有她自己的车。

example.en: We should plant more trees to protect our natural environment.
example.cn: 我们应该多种树来保护我们的自然环境。

words.meaning: 兴奋；激动；刺激；热情；令人激动的事；令人兴奋的事物

example.en: Their faces were full of excitement when they won the game.
example.cn: 当他们赢得比赛时，脸上充满了兴奋。

example.en: The government provided support too.
example.cn: 政府也提供了支持。

example.en: His English writing skills have shown great improvement this term.
example.cn: 这学期他的英语写作能力有了很大进步。

items.meaning: 表“性质、状态或特点”
items.rule: **构词规律:** Adjective + -ness -> Noun (性质/状态) | **本后缀词数:** 2

example.en: He missed three days of school because of a serious illness.
example.cn: 他因为一场重病缺课三天。

example.en: We will always remember the kindness and help our neighbors gave us.
example.cn: 我们将永远铭记邻居们给予我们的善良与帮助。

items.meaning: 表“性质、状态、能力或程度”
items.rule: **构词规律:** Adjective + -ity / -ty -> Abstract Noun | **本后缀词数:** 7

example.en: Find good sports players in your school. Talk about their abilities.
example.cn: 在学校里找找擅长运动的学生，聊聊他们的特长。

example.en: Activity
example.cn: 活动

example.en: Circle the words that they use to describe their personalities.
example.cn: 圈出他们用来描述自己性格特点的词汇。

example.en: AI will improve the quality of our future life.
example.cn: 人工智能将提高我们未来生活的质量。

example.en: For your own safety, please wear a helmet when riding a bicycle.
example.cn: 为了您自身的安全，骑自行车时请佩戴头盔。

example.en: Voluntary work helps students understand the needs of society better.
example.cn: 志愿者工作有助于学生更好地了解社会的需求。

example.en: Sue got into her dream university!
example.cn: 苏考上了她梦想中的大学！

items.meaning: 表“行为、状态、性质或发生”
items.rule: **构词规律:** Verb / Adjective + -ance / -ence -> Abstract Noun | **本后缀词数:** 10

example.en: I have full confidence in your ability to pass the final exam.
example.cn: 我对你通过期末考试的能力充满信心。

example.en: How do we understand differences?
example.cn: 我们该如何理解差异？

example.en: The bird covered the distance in three minutes.
example.cn: 这只鸟在三分钟内飞完了这段距离。

words.meaning: 经历；经验 `v.` 体验；经历

example.en: I don't think my brother Peter is enjoying the experience very much
example.cn: 我觉得我哥哥彼得并不是很享受这段经历。

example.en: The teacher explained the great importance of regular exercise.
example.cn: 老师阐明了规律锻炼身体的巨大重要性。

example.en: Emotional intelligence helps us build stronger relationships with friends.
example.cn: 情商有助于我们与朋友建立更深厚的关系。

example.en: Teaching young children requires a great deal of patience and love.
example.cn: 教小孩子需要极大的耐心和爱心。

example.en: The performance starts at seven.
example.cn: 演出七点开始。

example.en: Do you have any personal preference for tea or coffee?
example.cn: 你对茶还是咖啡有什么个人偏爱吗？

words.meaning: 沉默, 寂静, 无声 `v.` 使安静, 使不说话

example.en: There was a complete silence in the room as the teacher began to speak.
example.cn: 当老师开始讲话时，房间里一片寂静。

items.meaning: 表“时期、身份、关系、技能或状态”
items.rule: **构词规律:** Noun + -hood / -ship -> Abstract Noun | **本后缀词数:** 3

example.en: It is a quiet and friendly neighborhood to live in.
example.cn: 这是一个居住安静且友好的街区。

example.en: What can similarities bring to a friendship?
example.cn: 相似之处能给友谊带来什么？

example.en: I have quite a good relationship with my parents.
example.cn: 我和父母的关系相当不错。

items.meaning: 动名词/物/动作) (表“动作、活动、产物或集合物”
items.rule: **构词规律:** Verb + -ing -> Noun (活动/事物) | **本后缀词数:** 14

example.en: The classroom building is behind the sports field.
example.cn: 教学楼在运动场后面。

example.en: It's nine o'clock in the evening.
example.cn: 现在是晚上九点。

words.meaning: 感觉，情感，想法，态度、意见，看法

example.en: Can you read with feeling?
example.cn: 你能带着感情朗读吗？

example.en: A friendly smile and a warm greeting make everyone feel welcome.
example.cn: 一个友善的微笑和一句亲切的问候让每个人都感到宾至如归。

example.en: Lu hopes her readers can learn the cultural meaning behind the clothing.
example.cn: 露希望她的读者能了解服装背后的文化含义。

example.en: If we have a face-to-face meeting, we'll understand each other better.
example.cn: 如果我们进行面对面的会议，我们会更好地了解彼此。

example.en: Good morning!
example.cn: 早上好！

example.en: But the paintings of the Mogao Caves were so beautiful.
example.cn: 但是莫高窟的壁画太美了。

example.en: He spent his summer vacation learning sailing on the lake.
example.cn: 他把暑假时间都用来在湖上学帆船运动了。

example.en: Well, you know the saying, 'Early to bed, early to rise!'
example.cn: 嗯，你知道那句俗语，“起得早，睡得早！”

example.en: We often go grocery shopping together on Sunday mornings.
example.cn: 我们经常在周日早上一起去买菜。

example.en: We will start our sightseeing tour right away after breakfast.
example.cn: 吃完早饭后我们将立即开始观光游览。

example.en: It was very hot and our training was hard.
example.cn: 天气非常热，我们的训练很艰苦。

items.meaning: 表“学术门类、专门学科或特定活动”
items.rule: **构词规律:** Root / -ic + -s -> Noun (学科/专门活动) | **本后缀词数:** 4

example.en: Tom is good at athletics, especially running and high jump.
example.cn: 汤姆擅长体育运动，尤其是跑步和跳高。

words.meaning: (lyrics) 歌词；抒情诗 `adj.` 抒情的

example.en: The song has touching lyrics that express deep love for home.
example.cn: 这首歌有着感人的歌词，表达了对家乡的深切热爱。

example.en: I'm going to study Physics.
example.cn: 我打算学习物理。

example.en: He is keenly interested in world politics and current affairs.
example.cn: 他对世界政治和时事非常感兴趣。

groups.category_name: 构成形容词的后缀 (Adjective Suffixes)

items.meaning: 表“具有……性质的，处于……状态的”
items.rule: **构词规律:** Verb / Noun + -ant / -ent -> Adjective | **本后缀词数:** 10

example.en: you have to tell your teacher about it when you are absent from class.
example.cn: 当你旷课时，你必须把这件事告诉你的老师。

example.en: I feel much more confident about the presentation than I felt this morning.
example.cn: 比起今天早晨，我现在对这次演示演讲有信心多了。

example.en: Taking the high-speed train is very convenient and saves time.
example.cn: 乘坐高铁非常方便而且节省时间。

example.en: My sister looks very different.
example.cn: 我姐姐看起来很不一样。

example.en: My music teacher is excellent.
example.cn: 我的音乐老师非常优秀。

example.en: Yes, we put up important notices there.
example.cn: 是的，我们在那里张贴重要的通知。

words.meaning: 独立的；自主的；公正的；自治的

example.en: Going away to study has made him much more independent.
example.cn: 离开家去求学让他变得更加独立。

example.en: Dolphins are known to be highly intelligent marine animals.
example.cn: 海豚以高度聪明的海洋动物而闻名。

example.en: Guangzhou has a pleasant temperature in January.
example.cn: 广州在一月有着宜人的气温。

words.meaning: 沉默的, 无声的, 安静的

example.en: The students remained silent while listening to the national anthem.
example.cn: 学生们在听国歌时保持安静。

items.meaning: 充满……的，富有……的，具有……性质的
items.rule: **构词规律:** Noun / Verb + -ful -> Adjective | **本后缀词数:** 13

example.en: She's a beautiful dog.
example.cn: 她是一只漂亮的狗。

example.en: Be careful, my girl!
example.cn: 小心点，我的女孩！

example.en: My grandfather is getting a little forgetful as he gets older.
example.cn: 随着年龄增长，我爷爷变得有点健忘。

example.en: Plastic waste is extremely harmful to sea creatures.
example.cn: 塑料垃圾对海洋生物极其有害。

words.meaning: 有帮助的；有用的；有益的；愿意帮忙的

example.en: Wenwen is so helpful.
example.cn: 雯雯真热心（爱帮忙）。

example.en: The quiet village in the countryside is very peaceful and relaxing.
example.cn: 乡村里那个安静的小村庄非常宁静且令人放松。

words.meaning: 开玩笑的；逗笑的，顽皮的

example.en: Small and playful
example.cn: 小巧而顽皮

example.en: If someone set me free, I would make them rich and powerful.
example.cn: 如果有人放了我，我会让他们变得富有而强大。

example.en: She was proud to be a successful young scientist.
example.cn: 她为自己能成为一名成功的年轻科学家而感到骄傲。

example.en: Always give a truthful answer when someone asks for your honest opinion.
example.cn: 当别人征求你坦诚的意见时，一定要给出真实的回答。

words.meaning: 有用的, 实用的, 好的

example.en: My favourite subject is English. It's useful, and my English teacher is really nice.
example.cn: 我最喜欢的科目是英语。它很有用，而且我的英语老师非常好。

words.meaning: 精彩的, 绝妙的, 令人惊奇的

example.en: You're a wonderful friend.
example.cn: 你是一个了不起的朋友。

example.en: Even in her seventies, she always keeps a bright and youthful smile.
example.cn: 即使到了七十岁，她依然保持着灿烂而年轻的微笑。

items.meaning: 无……的，没有……的，不……的
items.rule: **构词规律:** Noun / Verb + -less -> Adjective (反义) | **本后缀词数:** 5

words.meaning: 不关心的；不注意的；粗心的

example.en: He lost valuable marks in the test because of a careless mistake.
example.cn: 他因为一个粗心的错误在考试中失掉了宝贵的分数。

example.en: Never give up easily even when the situation seems completely hopeless.
example.cn: 即使局势看起来完全绝望，也永远不要轻易放弃。

words.meaning: 无生命的；无生物生长的

example.en: Without water and air, the surface of the moon remains completely lifeless.
example.cn: 没有水和空气，月球表面依然毫无生机。

words.meaning: 有意义的，意味深长的；有所企图的 / 无意义的；不重要的

example.en: Arguments without clear facts and logic are completely meaningless.
example.cn: 没有清晰事实和逻辑的争论是完全毫无意义的。

words.meaning: 阳光照射不到的, 阴暗的

example.en: The deep forest remained dark and sunless even at midday.
example.cn: 即使在正午，这片深邃的森林依然黑暗且不见阳光。

items.meaning: 能……的，可以……的，适合……的
items.rule: **构词规律:** Verb / Noun + -able / -ible -> Adjective | **本后缀词数:** 7

example.en: The hotel was nice, with a comfortable bed, and everything was very clean.
example.cn: 这家酒店很好，有一张舒服的床，而且每样东西都很干净。

example.en: It is becoming fashionable among teenagers to wear traditional clothes.
example.cn: 在青少年中穿传统服饰正在变得非常流行。

words.meaning: 合理的，公平的，可以接受的

example.en: Do you think the price and suggestions in the plan are reasonable?
example.cn: 你认为该计划中的价格和建议是合理的吗？

words.meaning: 不舒服的, 不自在的, 棘手的

example.en: I felt a bit uncomfortable wearing these new shoes.
example.cn: 穿着这双新鞋，我感到有点不舒服。

words.meaning: 难忘的, 难以忘怀的

example.en: Our trip to Beijing last summer will always be an unforgettable experience.
example.cn: 我们去年夏天的北京之行将永远是一次难忘的经历。

example.en: It is important to develop valuable skills.
example.cn: 培养有价值的技能是很重要的。

words.meaning: 可怕的；糟糕的, 危害极大的；非常严重的；(感觉或看起来)病得很重的

example.en: It was terrible!
example.cn: 太糟糕了！

items.meaning: 多……的，充满……的，有……特征的
items.rule: **构词规律:** Noun + -y -> Adjective | **本后缀词数:** 17

example.en: She's an angry cat.
example.cn: 她是一只爱生气的猫。

example.en: It's cloudy, cloudy, cloudy.
example.cn: 天是阴沉的，阴沉的，阴沉的。

example.en: The cute boy has natural curly black hair.
example.cn: 这个可爱的男孩有一头天生的黑色卷发。

example.en: Bobby, stop! Look! It's so dirty now!
example.cn: 博比，停下！看！现在太脏了！

example.en: She's a funny dog.
example.cn: 它是一只滑稽的小狗。

example.en: Help me stay healthy.
example.cn: 帮我保持健康。

words.meaning: (1) 重的；沉的；(2) (在数量、程度等方面)超出一般的；比一般严重的

example.en: I get too heavy.
example.cn: 我变得太重了。

example.en: Drivers must take extra care when driving along icy mountain roads.
example.cn: 司机在结冰的山路上开车时必须格外小心。

example.en: Match each word with its opposite. fast shy late tall lazy loud funny
example.cn: 把每个词和它的反义词配对。快 害羞 晚 高 懒 吵闹 有趣

example.en: Wow, lucky you!
example.cn: 哇，你真走运！

example.en: The street outside our classroom was noisy because of the traffic.
example.cn: 因为交通原因，我们教室外面的街道很吵。

example.en: It's rainy, rainy, rainy.
example.cn: 外面在下雨，下雨，下雨。

example.en: The cook added too much salt, so the soup tasted far too salty.
example.cn: 厨师放了太多盐，所以汤尝起来太咸了。

example.en: It is easy to feel sleepy and find it hard to focus on our work or studies if we don't eat breakfast.
example.cn: 如果我们不吃早餐，很容易感到困倦，并且很难集中精力工作或学习。

example.en: It's snowy, snowy, snowy.
example.cn: 下雪了，下雪了，下雪了。

words.meaning: 阳光充足的, 晴朗的

example.en: It's sunny, sunny, sunny.
example.cn: 今天是晴朗、晴朗、晴朗的一天。

words.meaning: 多风的, 风大的；夸夸其谈的

example.en: It's windy, windy, windy.
example.cn: 天刮风了，刮风了，刮风了。

items.meaning: 属于……的，具有……性质的
items.rule: **构词规律:** Noun + -al -> Adjective | **本后缀词数:** 17

example.en: People in central China went there by the ancient Silk Road.
example.cn: 中国中部的人们通过古代丝绸之路去那里。

words.meaning: 化学的；含有化学物质的；化学作用的 `n.` 化学品；化学制品

example.en: We should wear safety glasses when doing chemical experiments in the lab.
example.cn: 我们在实验室做化学实验时应该戴上安全眼镜。

example.en: Listening to classical music can help you relax after a busy day.
example.cn: 听古典音乐可以帮你在忙碌的一天后放松下来。

words.meaning: 最终的；最后的 `n.` 决赛

example.en: I went into the final exam with great confidence.
example.cn: 我怀着巨大的自信走进了期末考试。

example.en: And we celebrate International Nurses Day on 12th May.
example.cn: 我们在5月12日庆祝国际护士节。

words.meaning: 地方的；本地的 `n.` 当地人；本地人

example.en: I want to try all the delicious local food.
example.cn: 我想尝尝所有美味的当地食物。

words.meaning: 医疗的；医学的；体格检查

example.en: China will take steps to improve medical services.
example.cn: 中国将采取措施改善医疗服务。

words.meaning: 音乐的；有音乐的 `n.` 音乐剧

example.en: I can't play any musical instruments.
example.cn: 我不会演奏任何乐器。

example.en: When is China's National Day?
example.cn: 中国的国庆节是什么时候？

example.en: Nature: The most famous national parks around the world
example.cn: 自然：世界上最著名的国家公园

words.meaning: 正常的；平常的；正规的；标准的 `n.` 常态；通常标准

example.en: It is completely normal to feel a bit nervous before an exam.
example.cn: 考试前感到有点紧张是完全正常的。

example.en: Don't ask about other people's personal information.
example.cn: 不要询问别人的个人信息。

example.en: She received professional training in dancing from an early age.
example.cn: 她从小就接受了专业的舞蹈训练。

example.en: Social media is becoming a big part of teenagers' lives.
example.cn: 社交媒体正在成为青少年生活中的一个重要部分。

words.meaning: 特别的；特殊的；专门的 `n.` 特产；特价；特别节目

example.en: What's special in your classroom?
example.cn: 你们的教室有什么特别之处？

example.en: More and more young people are learning traditional Chinese medicine.
example.cn: 越来越多的年轻人正在学习中医学（传统中国医学）。

words.meaning: 典型的, 特有的, 独特的

example.en: A bowl of warm noodles is a typical traditional breakfast in northern China.
example.cn: 一碗热腾腾的面条中国北方典型的传统早餐。

items.meaning: 表“……的，具有……性质/特征的”
items.rule: **构词规律:** Noun / Root + -ic -> Adjective | **本后缀词数:** 13

words.meaning: 艺术的美术的；有艺术性的；有美感的；精美的；有艺术鉴赏力的；有艺术修养的；有艺术天赋的

example.en: She has a great artistic talent and loves painting traditional Chinese landscapes.
example.cn: 她很有艺术天赋，喜欢画中国传统山水画。

example.en: The glass doors of the supermarket open automatically when you approach.
example.cn: 当你走近时，超市的玻璃门会自动打开。

example.en: Food and clean water are basic human needs.
example.cn: 食物和干净的水是人类的基本需求。

words.meaning: 典型的 `n.` 经典作品，杰作

example.en: People today can still learn a lot from classic works written in ancient times.
example.cn: 今天的人们仍然可以从古代写就的经典著作中学到很多东西。

example.en: Many people ride electric bicycles to work in our city.
example.cn: 在我们城市，许多人骑电动自行车去上班。

example.en: You should turn off your electronic devices during the exam.
example.cn: 考试期间你应该关掉电子设备。

example.en: I always feel very energetic after doing morning sports.
example.cn: 做完晨练后，我总是感到精力充沛。

example.en: The school concert was fantastic and everyone enjoyed it.
example.cn: 学校的音乐会太棒了，每个人都看得很尽兴。

example.en: Beijing is the first city to host both the Summer and Winter Olympic Games.
example.cn: 北京是第一座既举办过夏季奥运会又举办过冬季奥运会的城市。

example.en: We should reduce using single-use plastic bags to protect our environment.
example.cn: 我们应该减少使用一次性塑料袋来保护我们的环境。

example.en: AI will help us build a smart public transport system.
example.cn: 人工智能将帮助我们构建智能公共交通系统。

words.meaning: 现实的，逼真的，实际的，能够实现的

example.en: We need to set realistic goals that we can actually achieve.
example.cn: 我们需要设定能够真正实现的现实目标。

words.meaning: 具体的, 特定的, 明确的

example.en: Scanning is looking at the text quickly to find specific information, such as dates or numbers.
example.cn: 略读是快速浏览文本以寻找特定信息（如日期或数字）的方法。

items.meaning: 充满……的，具有……特征的
items.rule: **构词规律:** Noun + -ous -> Adjective | **本后缀词数:** 10

example.en: Young children are always curious about how things work around them.
example.cn: 小孩子们总是对周围事物如何运转充满好奇。

example.en: because they're dangerous / scary/...
example.cn: 因为它们很危险 / 可怕 / ……

example.en: They make delicious jiaozi.
example.cn: 他们做出了美味的饺子。

example.en: Xu Xiake is one of the most famous travellers in China.
example.cn: 徐霞客是中国最著名的旅行家之一。

example.en: It was generous of him to donate money to the poor children.
example.cn: 他慷慨解囊向贫困儿童捐款，真是太大方了。

example.en: Mr White is a humorous teacher who often tells funny stories in class.
example.cn: 怀特先生是一位幽默的老师，经常在课堂上讲有趣的故事。

example.en: Do you get nervous when you talk to someone?
example.cn: 你和别人说话时会紧张吗？

example.en: Time is as precious as gold, so we should make good use of every minute.
example.cn: 时间如金钱般宝贵，所以我们应该充分利用每一分钟。

example.en: Appearance Personality Habit Strength
example.cn: 外貌、性格、习惯、长处

example.en: The school library provides books on various subjects from history to art.
example.cn: 学校图书馆提供从历史到艺术等各个学科的书籍。

items.meaning: 具有……性质的，有……倾向的
items.rule: **构词规律:** Verb / Noun + -ive -> Adjective | **本后缀词数:** 5

example.en: She takes an active part in school activities.
example.cn: 她积极参加学校的各项活动。

example.en: In the future, humans will focus more on creative and challenging tasks.
example.cn: 在未来，人类将更加专注于富有创造性和挑战性的任务。

example.en: Watches are so expensive.
example.cn: 手表太贵了。

words.meaning: 积极的；肯定的 `n.` 优势；优点

example.en: Try to stay positive and active.
example.cn: 尽量保持积极向上和活跃。

words.meaning: 相对的，比较的，关于的 `n.` 亲戚，亲属

example.en: We visited all our close relatives and had dinner together during the Spring Festival.
example.cn: 春节期间，我们拜访了所有的近亲，并聚在一起吃晚饭。

items.meaning: 由……制成的，由……构成的
items.rule: **构词规律:** Noun + -en -> Adjective | **本后缀词数:** 2

example.en: The morning sun cast a golden light over the quiet village.
example.cn: 清晨的阳光把金色的光辉洒在宁静的村庄上。

words.meaning: 木制的, 木头的, 呆板的

example.en: There is a lovely wooden bridge across the small river.
example.cn: 小河上有一座可爱的小木桥。

items.meaning: 感到……的分词形容词) (表人主观感到……的，处于某种状态的
items.rule: **构词规律:** Verb + -ed -> Adjective (Passive/Feeling) | **本后缀词数:** 12

example.en: I felt bored, so I decided to look for something to read.
example.cn: 我觉得很无聊，所以决定找点书读。

example.en: The subway station is always crowded during the morning rush hour.
example.cn: 早高峰时地铁站总是很拥挤。

example.en: I'm excited, and also sad.
example.cn: 我很激动，也很难过。

example.en: The little girl was not frightened by the sudden loud noise.
example.cn: 小女孩没有被突然的巨大声响吓到。

words.meaning: 感兴趣的，关心的，表现出兴趣的

example.en: I'm interested in nature.
example.cn: 我对大自然感兴趣。

example.en: Our teacher was very pleased with the progress we made this term.
example.cn: 我们老师对我们这学期取得的进步感到非常高兴。

example.en: Listening to soft music always makes me feel peaceful and relaxed.
example.cn: 听柔和的音乐总能让我感到平静和放松。

example.en: I turned around and was surprised to see a deer.
example.cn: 我转过身去，惊讶地看到了一只鹿。

example.en: She is a talented pianist who began playing concerts at age eight.
example.cn: 她是一位才华横溢的钢琴家，八岁时就开始登台演奏音乐会。

example.en: Sometimes Mum feels tired.
example.cn: 有时候妈妈会觉得累。

example.en: Mum looked worried when I came home late after dark.
example.cn: 我天黑后很晚才回家，妈妈看上去很担心。

words.meaning: 受伤的, 负伤的, 受伤害的

example.en: The doctor rushed over to bandage the wounded soldier's arm.
example.cn: 医生急忙跑过去包扎受伤士兵的手臂。

items.meaning: 令人……的分词形容词) (表事物具有令他人产生某种感受特性的
items.rule: **构词规律:** Verb + -ing -> Adjective (Active/Characteristic) | **本后缀词数:** 7

example.en: Because maths is boring to me.
example.cn: 因为我觉得数学很无聊。

words.meaning: 令人激动的；使人兴奋的

example.en: PE, because it's exciting.
example.cn: 体育课，因为它很令人兴奋。

words.meaning: 可怕的，使人惊恐的，骇人的

example.en: Thunderstorms can be frightening for small children.
example.cn: 雷雨对小孩子来说可能是可怕的。

example.en: It's interesting to learn about the past.
example.cn: 了解过去是很有趣的。

example.en: The police are still searching for the missing child in the forest.
example.cn: 警察仍在森林里搜寻那个失踪的孩子。

example.en: Taking a warm bath after sports is very comfortable and relaxing.
example.cn: 运动后来个热水澡非常舒服且放松。

words.meaning: 愿意, 乐意的, 自愿的

example.en: She is always willing to lend a helping hand to classmates in need.
example.cn: 她总是乐意向需要帮助的同学伸出援手。

items.meaning: 表方式、程度、频率或时间：“……地”
items.rule: **构词规律:** Adjective + -ly -> Adverb | **本后缀词数:** 30

words.meaning: 的确；真实地；事实上；实际上

example.en: Exactly! Actually we eat bamboo shoots too.
example.cn: 完全正确！其实我们也吃竹笋。

example.en: It reminds us that war is terrible and peace does not come easily.
example.cn: 它提醒我们战争是残酷的，和平来之不易。

example.en: Everything tasted good, especially the steamed chicken soup.
example.cn: 每样东西都很好吃，尤其是清炖鸡汤。

words.meaning: (1) 精确地；确切地；准确地；(2) (用于强调正确)完全正确

example.en: Exactly! How about Ella?
example.cn: 完全正确！埃拉呢？

example.en: The English exam was fairly easy, so most students finished on time.
example.cn: 英语考试相当简单，所以大多数学生都按时完成了。

example.en: The loyal dog waited faithfully for his master outside the door.
example.cn: 那只忠诚的狗在门外忠实地等待着它的主人。

example.en: Fortunately, we missed the heavy traffic.
example.cn: 幸运的是，我们避开了大堵车。

example.en: The weather is gradually getting warmer as spring arrives.
example.cn: 随着春天的到来，天气正逐渐变暖。

example.en: Emma: Hardly ever.
example.cn: 埃玛：几乎从不。

example.en: It's raining heavily.
example.cn: 外面正下着大雨。

example.en: When the bell rang, the students went back to their classrooms immediately.
example.cn: 铃声一响，学生们立刻回到了教室。

example.en: The dog starts to bark very loudly.
example.cn: 狗开始非常大声地吠叫。

example.en: Luckily, nobody was hurt in the accident.
example.cn: 幸好事故中没有人受伤。

example.en: What does the passage mainly talk about?
example.cn: 这篇文章主要讲了什么？

example.en: Our students are mostly from the surrounding towns and villages.
example.cn: 我们的学生大多来自周边的城镇和村庄。

example.en: It's nearly the end.
example.cn: 接近尾声了。

example.en: Emma usually asks politely, "Would you like some?"
example.cn: 艾玛通常会礼貌地问：“你想来一点吗？”

example.en: Could you possibly help me carry this heavy box upstairs?
example.cn: 你能帮我把这个沉重的箱子搬上楼吗？

example.en: The passage is most probably an advertisement.
example.cn: 这篇文章很可能是一则广告。

example.en: The fire is now growing very quickly.
example.cn: 大火现在蔓延得非常快。

example.en: Shh, we must talk quietly in the library.
example.cn: 嘘，我们在图书馆里必须轻声说话。

example.en: She rarely eats sweet cakes because she cares about her teeth.
example.cn: 她很少吃甜蛋糕，因为她很爱护牙齿。

words.meaning: 真正地，确实地，非常，真的

example.en: She can play it really well!
example.cn: 她弹得真好！

example.en: I simply cannot believe that he finished that difficult task so quickly.
example.cn: 我简直不敢相信他这么快就完成了那个高难度的任务。

example.en: Surprisingly, the little boy solved the difficult math puzzle in minutes.
example.cn: 出人意料的是，这个小男孩在几分钟内就解开了这个困难的数学谜题。

example.en: I am truly grateful for all the kind support you have given me.
example.cn: 我衷心感谢您给予我的所有亲切支持。

words.meaning: 不幸地, 遗憾地, 可惜地

example.en: Unfortunately, it started to rain heavily just as we were going out.
example.cn: 不幸的是，我们刚出门天就下起了大雨。

words.meaning: 通常, 一般地, 经常地

example.en: What time do you usually get up?
example.cn: 你通常几点起床？

words.meaning: 广泛地, 很大程度上, 普遍的

example.en: English is widely spoken in many countries around the world.
example.cn: 英语在世界上许多国家被广泛使用。

example.en: To make your resolutions work, you need to plan them wisely.
example.cn: 为了让你的决心发挥作用，你需要明智地规划它们。

items.rule: **构词规律:** Noun / Preposition + -ward(s) -> Adverb | **本后缀词数:** 2

words.meaning: 向前，向将来 `v.` 转寄；转投；发送；寄(商品或信息)

example.en: I'm looking forward to seeing you soon!
example.cn: 我期待着很快见到你！

example.en: The ship sailed westwards across the blue ocean.
example.cn: 轮船向西航行，穿过蔚蓝的大海。

items.meaning: 使成为，使……化
items.rule: **构词规律:** Noun / Adjective + -ize / -ise -> Verb | **本后缀词数:** 2

example.en: You should apologize to your classmate for breaking his ruler.
example.cn: 你弄坏了同学的尺子，应该向他道歉。

example.en: The program, called Riding for Focus (R4F), was organized by the nonprofit Outride.
example.cn: 这个名为“专注骑行”的项目是由非营利组织Outride组织的。
